subject: English
passage: Fusion power plants promise to generate clean energy by replicating the nuclear reactions that power the sun, potentially solving the world's energy crisis without harmful emissions. Though fusion researchers worldwide have spent decades pursuing this breakthrough, their goal remains elusive. ______ of the experimental fusion reactors built so far, none has achieved sustained energy production that exceeds the energy required to operate it.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. "In fact" logically signals that this sentence about fusion reactors provides evidence that emphasizes and reinforces the previous statement—that none of the experimental reactors has achieved the breakthrough needed to make fusion power viable.
